name: com.pattarapol.smart-tooltip
description: Tutorial tooltips that point at anything: UI, 2D sprites, 3D objects, even things off screen or behind the camera. The screen dims, a hole opens around the target, and rules pick which tip to show.

samples.description: A small game menu built from code. Shows the director picking tips, holds, cooldowns and every end reason, with a live log.
Tips that start for targets off screen or behind the camera. An orbiting camera, a runner that leaves the screen and an object turned in depth.
